name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Major release: station-intelligence features plus backup/restore. New Step 2 'Journey' programming type drifts a station from a start track toward an end mood across the day (AudioMuse find_path), looping each night. New Step 5 options: 'Smooth Transitions' orders each refill by harmonic/tempo compatibility (Camelot-style key + BPM), and 'Time-of-Day Energy (Daypart)' biases refills toward calmer or higher-energy tracks by the local hour. Settings gains Backup & Restore: download all channel designs and living pools as a JSON file (credentials excluded) and restore by merge-on-slug. The three playback features are executed by Alchemy FM on refill, so update the Alchemy FM backend to match this plugin.

Add a Station Artwork picker to Step 1 so you can attach art before a station ever exists, not just afterward from the edit toolbar. Alchemy FM's artwork endpoint requires a station id, which doesn't exist until the first successful deploy, so the staged file uploads automatically the moment Deploy creates or updates the station; a failed upload is a warning, not a blocker on the rest of the deploy. Main designer form now uses multipart/form-data.
